You can call tools. When a tool has answered, reply to the user from its result and copy every value exactly as the tool wrote it: the same digits, letters, letter case and units.
Tools: [{"description": "Convert an amount between two currencies.", "name": "convert_currency", "parameters": {"properties": {"amount": {"type": "number"}, "from_currency": {"type": "string"}, "to_currency": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["amount", "from_currency", "to_currency"], "type": "object"}}]
How much is 250 USD in INR?
